Snapshot: candidate 274f263c4c8ca42d2fc4f6dc3efcd3eb6fb5fd37; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 1a43613bf3d40b05f267d0b055c9555d436ea332. Opening and closing gates both succeeded; five new stroke files raw-identical.
Scope: Read every requested guidance/rubric, primary lesson, 25 context pair, 14 linked pair, 20 KANJIDIC2 record, radical/header, 55 JMdict entry, five KanjiPedia text, all 424 typed pool rows, 15 proposals, five adjudications, five clarifications, five limit notes, and all 12 navigation diffs; every window returned completely with exit 0. No comparison bodies were assigned. No web pages read.
C1 CLEAN: Five lessons agree with frozen source and read KANJIDIC2, radical, JMdict and KanjiPedia evidence for the assigned Japanese facts; no confirmed correctable Japanese-content defect.
C2 NEEDS FIX: All 12 edits are exact navigation wrappers to valid existing kanji paths; whole-word readings remain intact. Four distractor edges are unsafe as unqualified reading negatives (N001, N004, N007, N013); N009 remains U for ordinary negative safety.
C3 CLEAN: Five new lessons and wrapped word-page prose are understandable Russian, with no confirmed correctable clarity/naturalness defect.
N001昔→借 REJECT: Accurate shape comparison for introduction only; both characters have シャク, so 借 is not an unqualified wrong reading choice.
N002昔→春 S-intro: 日/vertical-shape comparison; meanings and readings are distinct.
N003昔→景 S-intro: Accurate 日/vertical-composition comparison; past vs view meanings are distinct.
N004景→京 REJECT: Accurate shape comparison for introduction only; both have ケイ and 京 is the lower sound component.
N005景→高 S-intro: Contour comparison; scenery vs height/price meanings and ケイ/コウ are distinct.
N006景→暗 S-intro: Vertical vs side-by-side 日 composition; scenery vs darkness are distinct.
N007昨→作 REJECT: Accurate shape comparison for introduction only; both have サク and share 乍.
N008昨→晴 S-intro: Shared 日 shape, distinct readings and previous-time vs weather meanings.
N009昨→時 U: Shape comparison is sound; both occupy the time domain, so ordinary negative safety is not established by titles alone.
N010晩→勉 S-intro: Shared 免-like shape; modern バン/ベン and evening/effort are distinct; historical phonetic relation is bounded.
N011晩→映 S-intro: Shared left 日, distinct readings and evening/image meanings.
N012晩→晴 S-intro: Shared left 日, distinct readings and evening/weather meanings.
N013晴→青 REJECT: Accurate shape comparison for introduction only; both have セイ and 青 is the sound component, matching the prior shared-reading rejection rationale.
N014晴→時 S-intro: Shared left 日; weather vs time/hour and セイ/ジ are distinct.
N015晴→晩 S-intro: Shared left 日; clear-weather vs evening/night meanings and セイ/バン are distinct.
L001昔 SUPPORTED: Core readings, readings/meaning distinctions, source-attributed 象形 account and explicitly modern mnemonic supported.
L002景 SUPPORTED: Core ケイ, no standard kun reading, [外] エイ, attributed 形声 account and examples supported.
L003昨 SUPPORTED: サク and whole-word jukujikun preserved; [外] きのう, 昨年 register and cited compounds supported.
L004晩 SUPPORTED: バン, time range, 晚 11-stroke old form, 早 late-sense contrast and bounded phonetic history supported.
L005晴 SUPPORTED: readings, word senses, figurative glosses, attributed 靑/セイ analysis and mnemonic distinction supported.
A001 SUPPORTED: 昔 / 昔話 meanings bounded; no frequency claim.
A002 SUPPORTED: 風景, 夜景 and 景 entries supported; no frequency claim.
A003 SUPPORTED: 昨夜 readings and JMdict formal-or-literary label for 昨年 accurately bounded.
A004 SUPPORTED: JMdict lists the spellings 晩ご飯/晩ごはん; 今晩は greeting is usually kana. No frequency claim.
A005 SUPPORTED:晴れ/晴れる/晴天 meanings bounded, including figurative senses; no frequency claim.

Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001–O005 LIMIT_NOT_NEW_GUARD; all five observations match pool/context evidence and are out-of-pool relationships, not new quiz edges.
Findings: F001 kanji/昔.md front-matter distractors (line 11), 昔→借: shared シャク makes it a correct reading response if readings are tested. Replace or constrain to shape-only/meaning-only use. KANJIDIC2 entries 6614/501f and linked lessons confirm; confidence high. F002 kanji/景.md line 11, 景→京: both read ケイ and 京 is explicitly 景's phonetic component; unsafe as an unqualified reading negative. Replace/constrain. KANJIDIC2 666f/4eac and KanjiPedia 景 entry; high. F003 kanji/昨.md line 11, 昨→作: both read サク and share 乍; unsafe as an unqualified reading negative. Replace/constrain. KANJIDIC2 6628/4f5c and linked lesson; high. F004 kanji/晴.md line 11, 晴→青: both read セイ and 青/靑 is the sound component; unsafe as an unqualified reading negative. Replace/constrain. KANJIDIC2 6674/9752 and KanjiPedia 晴 entry; high. These do not assert Russian-title equivalence in a meaning-only quiz.
Optional: None.
Limits: No app quiz-mode/UI behavior was inspected; the four rejections concern reading-inclusive or unqualified active negatives, not proof of ambiguity in a meaning-only prompt. No external dictionary pages were fetched. Read only the assigned bound corpus, not the wider repository. No tests/builds/validators run as instructed.
